## Description

Use this skill when the user asks about technology vigilance: Structured technology monitoring across analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester, IDC), academic sources (Stanford HAI, IEEE, ACM), editorial platforms (O'Reilly Radar, ThoughtWorks Tech Radar), and individual thought leaders (Martin Fowler, Paulo Caroli, Gregor Hohpe, Jez Humble).

## Summary

Structured monitoring of the technology landscape to inform discovery decisions with up-to-date data on trends, maturity, adoption, and risks of proposed technologies.
